title: Back to School Tech Essentials: Must-Have Gadgets for Students in 2024
subtitle: A guide to the best tech gear for students heading back to class.

content:
Heading back to school in 2024? The best student gear prioritizes reliability, battery life and comfort—tools that make learning easier without constant troubleshooting. Below are essentials that consistently perform and are widely supported with updates.

1. MacBook Air M4

Lightweight and silent with excellent battery life. The keyboard and trackpad are class‑leading for note‑taking and long writing sessions. Check deal

2. Samsung Galaxy Tab S9

Responsive display, good pen support and reliable battery for reading, annotating and light creative work. Check deal

3. Sony WH‑1000XM5 Headphones

Industry‑leading ANC helps you focus in libraries and dorms. Comfortable fit for long study sessions. Check deal

4. Anker PowerCore Portable Charger

Dependable backup power for campus days. Look for USB‑C input/output and clear capacity labeling. Check deal

5. Logitech MX Master 3S

Comfortable ergonomics with precise tracking across surfaces; boosts productivity in spreadsheets and creative apps. Check deal

6. Kindle Paperwhite

Eye‑friendly reading with weeks of battery life. Great for assigned books and PDFs. Check deal

7. Affordable Printer

Choose models with inexpensive ink and simple Wi‑Fi setup—avoid proprietary subscriptions unless you know the cost. Browse options

8. Samsung T7 Portable SSD

Fast transfers for projects and backups with durable build. Check deal

Tips

  • Focus on reliability and battery life over raw specs.
  • Avoid ultra‑low‑res displays; they strain eyes.
  • Keep accessories simple: a good mouse, charger and case.
